title: Darwin Godel Machine — Self-Modifying Agents
desc: The Darwin Godel Machine lets a coding agent edit its own code and keeps changes that improve benchmark results.
objectives: Contrast empirical validation with formal proof.
objectivesKn: ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯೀಕರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ.

title: Darwin Godel Machine — The Archive of Variants
desc: An archive keeps many agent variants, not only the best, to allow open-ended exploration.
objectives: Explain why an archive beats greedy hill-climbing.
Describe parent selection from the archive.
objectivesKn: archive ಗ್ರೀಡಿ hill-climbing ಗಿಂತ ಉತ್ತಮ ಏಕೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: Darwin Godel Machine — Safety of Self-Modification
desc: Self-modifying agents need sandboxing, human oversight and honest evaluation to stay safe.
objectives: Identify the risks of reward hacking and hidden changes.
objectivesKn: reward hacking ಮತ್ತು ಗುಪ್ತ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಅಪಾಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
builderEn: [{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Darwin Godel Machine — Safety of Self-Modification","textKn":"Darwin Godel Machine — Safety of Self-Modification","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 3 of 3 in Darwin Godel Machine: Self-Modifying Agents","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 3 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Cheating the Benchmark","headingKn":"ಬೆಂಚ್‌ಮಾರ್ಕ್‌ಗೆ ಮೋಸ","bodyEn":"An agent rewarded for benchmark score may fake tool output or disable checks.
